name: event-network
description: Search public Event Network directories and optionally read your accessible Event Network data with New Systems OAuth.

interface.longDescription: Search public Event Network companies, specialists, Cross Rental rentals, used-equipment listings, jobs, venues, rooms, technical plans, and shared availability without signing in. With New Systems OAuth, eight account-read tools use eventnetwork:read and job publication tools require the additional eventnetwork:write consent. Job publication asks for options in sequence, creates an encrypted one-time preview with no time-based expiry, and requires explicit confirmation before publishing. The server rechecks profile and company permissions on every protected call. Results omit private contacts, exact addresses, coordinates, and calendar events. Applications, bookings, messaging, and edits to existing records are not available. Unknown availability stays unknown; room-capacity filters do not guarantee seating capacity.
capabilities: Check shared rental equipment availability by date
Search public event venues by type, stars, capacity, and area
Read accessible personal and company profiles
Read your jobs, listings, matching jobs, purchase groups, and technical riders
Prepare and publish a job after user confirmation
defaultPrompt: Pokaż techniczne firmy eventowe i zweryfikuj ich publiczne usługi.
Znajdź używane konsole oświetleniowe na sprzedaż w Polsce.
Szukam hotelu minimum 4-gwiazdkowego dla 500 osób w okolicach Warszawy.

positive.description: Search public companies and specialists, retrieve allowlisted profiles, and check only confirmed specialist calendar availability.
positive.prompt: Znajdź firmę LS Project oraz specjalistów pracujących w Niemczech, otwórz ich publiczne profile i sprawdź status kalendarzy specjalistów na 18 września 2027.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches for LS Project and uses the returned companyId to retrieve its public profile. Also searches specialists whose public profile indicates Germany work coverage, uses returned specialistIds for public profiles and checks availability on 2027-09-18 in Europe/Berlin. Reports the exact status, including unknown, and profile links when returned. Does not imply availability at a specific venue, reveal calendar event details, or treat listed equipment as proof of operating proficiency.

positive.description: Check a shared rental listing’s available quantity for a requested date and distinguish unknown from zero.
positive.prompt: Ile sztuk Robe MegaPointe będzie dostępnych 18 września 2027?
positive.expected_behavior: Searches Robe MegaPointe listings with dateFrom 2027-09-18 and Europe/Warsaw. Reports the available quantity only when the tool returns a confirmed count. If availabilityStatus is unknown or sharing is disabled, says it cannot confirm the count; never changes unknown to zero or available.

positive.description: Find active second-hand equipment offers and keep marketplace results separate from rental inventory.
positive.prompt: Znajdź używane konsole oświetleniowe na sprzedaż w Polsce.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches active public used-equipment sale listings in Poland. Reports only returned listing details and prices, does not include private seller contacts, and does not infer quantity or date-specific availability.

positive.description: Search venues by hotel type, minimum stars, largest-room value, and radius around Warsaw.
positive.prompt: Szukam hotelu minimum 4-gwiazdkowego dla 500 osób w okolicach Warszawy.
positive.expected_behavior: Searches public hotel venues using at least 4 stars, a biggest_room value of at least 500, and a 50 km radius around Warszawa, Poland. Explains that biggest_room is a capacity proxy and advises confirming the exact seating layout with the venue.

positive.description: Connect through New Systems OAuth, list accessible account contexts, and read jobs only in an explicitly selected context.
positive.prompt: Połącz moje konto, pokaż dostępne profile i znajdź moje zlecenia dla wybranego profilu.
positive.expected_behavior: Completes the New Systems OAuth consent flow, lists only contexts accessible to the authenticated user, asks the user to choose a personal or company context when ambiguous, and calls get_my_jobs with that explicit context. Reports only returned data and links. It does not switch the user's active platform profile or expose data from another context.

negative.description: Decline requests for private contact information and exact addresses.
negative.prompt: Podaj prywatny telefon, e-mail i dokładny adres firmy.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not reveal or infer private contact details or precise addresses. Explains that this MCP provides only allowlisted public profile information.

negative.description: Do not present the venue largest-room filter as confirmed seating capacity.
negative.prompt: Czy ten hotel na pewno pomieści 500 osób przy ustawieniu teatralnym?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that biggest_room is the directory's largest-room value and does not confirm seating layout or guaranteed capacity; recommends confirming the requested setup with the venue. Does not expose exact address or private contacts.

negative.description: Reject inaccessible account contexts and decline booking or messaging while allowing confirmed job publication.
negative.prompt: Pokaż zlecenia firmy, do której nie mam dostępu, zarezerwuj sprzęt i napisz do firmy.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not reveal jobs from an inaccessible company context; the server rechecks existing Event Network permissions for every request. Does not attempt to book equipment or send a message. Job publishing is offered only for a permitted context and requires a preview and explicit user confirmation.
